## 自查 / Self-review

- [ ] 文档链接有效 / Document links resolve
- [ ] 中英文已同步，或明确标注翻译差异 / Both languages match, or translation gaps are explicitly marked
- [ ] 正文、历史、提交身份和附件不含隐私或保密资料 / Text, history, commit identities, and attachments contain no private or confidential information
- [ ] 已运行隐私检查，并人工检查上下文与元数据 / Privacy checks passed and context and metadata were reviewed manually
- [ ] 未把假设写成团队现状或成果 / Assumptions are not presented as current conditions or proven results
- [ ] 已说明责任、成本与验证方式 / Responsibilities, costs, and validation are described
- [ ] 已按需更新选题清单 / The topic backlog is updated where needed

## 后续事项 / Follow-up

是否需要试行、补充材料或进一步讨论？
